missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Поведение' is a neuter noun in the nominative as the subject. 'Его' shows whose it is, and 'странное' is the agreeing neuter adjective.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Поведение' is the accusative direct object of 'похвалил'; neuter inanimate nouns look identical in nominative and accusative. 'Хорошее' agrees.
Strategic focus: Genitive after negation. 'Поведения' takes the genitive after the negated 'не понимаю'. 'Такого' agrees in the neuter genitive.
Strategic focus: Dative after к. 'Поведению' is the dative form after 'к', marking what we got used to. 'Его' shows whose behaviour it is.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of cause. 'Поведением' is the instrumental form governed by 'удивлены', the cause of the surprise. 'Его' shows possession.
Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'Поведении' takes the prepositional form after 'в' to mean within his behaviour. 'Проблема' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Поведения' is the genitive form expressing the reason for the behaviour. 'Причина' is the nominative subject, and 'неясна' describes it.
Strategic focus: Accusative after за. 'Поведение' takes the accusative after 'за' to express the reason for praise. 'Хорошее' agrees, and 'детей хвалят' is the impersonal frame.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Поведения' is the nominative plural subject. 'Разные' agrees in the plural, and 'требуют разных подходов' uses the genitive plural object.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Поведение' is the accusative direct object of 'изучает'. 'Людей' is the genitive plural showing whose behaviour is studied.
